title: Activity Definitions (Base)
description: Shared activity type definitions. Level-specific schemas reference these.

vesum_exempt.description: If true, VESUM checker skips distractor validation for this activity (e.g., spelling quizzes with intentional misspellings)

notes.description: Internal notes about the activity (not shown to learners)

passage.description: Text with inline {correct|opt1|opt2|opt3} format OR numbered {1}, {2} with blanks array

error-correction.description: Find and fix grammatical errors, register issues, or phrase corrections

error.description: The incorrect word or phrase in the sentence

error_type.description: Type of correction (default: word). Use 'phrase' for multi-word corrections, 'register' for style transformations, 'construction' for grammatical structures.

explanation.description: Why the error is wrong and the answer is correct

mark-the-words.description: Click/mark words matching criteria in passage

instruction.description: What words to mark (e.g., 'Mark all nouns')

essay-response.description: Long-form writing task with model answer and rubric

source_reading.description: ID of the reading activity this essay refers to

critical-analysis.description: Deep analysis of a text or concept

source_reading.description: ID of the reading activity this analysis refers to

target_text.description: The text or excerpt to analyze

focus_points.description: Key elements to analyze (e.g. tone, bias)

comparative-study.description: Comparison of two or more texts/concepts

source_reading.description: ID of the reading activity this comparison refers to

authorial-intent.description: Evaluation of author's purpose and techniques

source_reading.description: ID of the reading activity this refers to

reading.description: Reading comprehension task with inline text OR external resource

etymology-trace.description: Trace word from OES to modern Ukrainian

paleography-analysis.description: Identify visual features of manuscripts via hotspots

options.description: List of possible feature terms (e.g., Ustav, Skoropys)

dialect-comparison.description: Side-by-side comparison of regional dialect features

translation-critique.description: Evaluate and critique modern translations of archaic texts

focus_points.description: Key words that are often mistranslated

law.description: Linguistic law being applied (e.g., Havlik's Law)

grammar-lab.description: Structured morphological analysis with focus field (ISSUE-502)

parallel-text.description: Compare passage across language stages or registers (ISSUE-502)

loanword-trace.description: Trace foreign borrowings (Greek, Polish, Latin, Turkic) (ISSUE-502)

comparative-style.description: Compare linguistic features across registers or periods (ISSUE-502)

zno-row-select.description: ZNO-format: select the row where ALL words match a rule (e.g., correct stress, spelling). Source: osyvokon/zno (MIT). ISSUE-715

question.description: What rule to check (e.g., 'Наголос на другому складі в усіх словах рядка')

rows.description: Each row is a comma-separated list of words

zno-sentence-select.description: ZNO-format: select the sentence that is grammatically/stylistically correct (or incorrect). Source: osyvokon/zno (MIT). ISSUE-715

zno-error-find.description: ZNO-format: find the error in a sentence or word list. Source: osyvokon/zno (MIT). ISSUE-715

options.description: Words or phrases, one of which contains an error

zno-fill-ending.description: ZNO-format: fill in the correct word ending (suffix, case ending, verb form). Source: osyvokon/zno (MIT). ISSUE-715

stem.description: Word stem or sentence with blank (e.g., 'учител_')

watch-and-repeat.description: Watch a video and repeat the pronunciation

image-to-letter.description: Match an image/emoji to the first letter of the Ukrainian word

image.description: Image/emoji representing the word (alias for emoji)

note.description: The Ukrainian word the image represents
